what_this_is: The Workshop rows for what Trillion told the person, in tools/tell-the-person, read from their own told-the-person records through the run's records door.

payload.label: What I was told, where it reached me and where I saw it
payload.job: List what Trillion told this person, newest first: each notice with every way it went (sent, waiting its turn, turned off or unavailable) and the surface the person saw it on
payload.description: Optional limit (up to 100, default 20) and kind (only notices of that kind, such as take-me-there). Returns notices, each { id, kind, title, at, open, read, read_on: { channel, device_id, at } when the person saw it, told: { channel: sent | a stage | not-sent }, why: { channel: what its sender said } for each way that did not carry it }, and said, the count and how many were seen, in words. It reads every notice Trillion keeps, whichever ways it went, and kind is applied before the newest are taken, so one kind is found however many of another came after it; an AI reads where the person saw something instead of guessing. It changes nothing.

kind.description: Only notices of this kind, such as take-me-there

stored.description: What this run reads of the person's own things, read by the caller from where the person keeps them (the engine keeps none) and given here: records: [{id, type, value}] of told-the-person, as this row's `stored` lists. What is not given is not there.

provenance.source: trillion src/tell-the-person.mjs recent(), the notices the open Trillion page shows, with read_on and told (a2fdfe6), ported to the records door

payload.label: Notices for this device
payload.job: Read the newest notices kept for one registered device, oldest first after its cursor
payload.description: Pass the device_id returned by notification-device registration. channel must match its route: device-pull for live, web-push or apns; omitted channel uses the registered route. after is the last cursor seen. Returns only notices queued or positively delivered to that device, oldest first, including body and offered actions. It changes nothing.

stored.description: What this run reads of the person's own things, read by the caller from where the person keeps them (the engine keeps none) and given here: records: [{id, type, value}] of notification-device (ids starting notification-device:), told-the-person, as this row's `stored` lists. What is not given is not there.

payload.label: Mark my notices read
payload.job: Record which notices this person has read and the first surface they saw them on
payload.description: Pass ids such as told:12, or a notification key, and optionally read=false to undo. on.channel names the surface (in-app, browser, watch, apns or device-pull); device_id says which registered device saw it. The first read surface is retained, so repeated reads never move it. Returns ids, read, changed, on and said.

live_heads._what: The record the engine's live screen heads read the told list's newest seq from (trillion-rust src/local_account/live_heads.rs, old trillion keptList.lastSeq over the told list): moved from the engine, which named it in code. With this tool not installed, the screen has no told head.

payload.label: Act on one of my notices
payload.job: Perform one action explicitly offered by one of this person’s kept notices
payload.description: Pass a notice id (told:<seq>) and the exact action id it offers; include text and a stable submission_id UUID for a reply. An explicit local open action returns done=true and its local path. Actions whose effect belongs to another source owner are refused unless that owner is available to this run; this tool never claims a post or agent action ran without its owner’s result.
